notes: a line the gateway served in the 2026-10-15 measurement kept trading: it is not an exit, and the archive cannot show it (its gateway series for leavers end at the last membership day)
GPS and FBHS are served as GAP and FBIN: renames, not exits
a 25-NSE does not prove a stock exit: it can delist a bond or preferred shares, or record a move to another exchange. The served lines with one since 2022 are in served_25nse, security not read

the exit-later test uses the 8-K's event date (reportDate) for Item 2.01 or 3.01 and counts NYSE sessions from the last membership session; C11 printed p.6 allows 'on or around' the last trading date, so a gap of one session is not 'later'
the event date is never the last trade date: WBD's says 2026-09-30 but it traded until 2026-10-05
INFO and WRK: no price is held; their event and 25-NSE dates are the filing facts
